There were many who doubted, but not Saoirse, she was special, of all the Naga, it was she who the Goddess had chosen.

After the loss of Sile, the group had been low. But she had held a ceremony, and they had fed the traitors hand to Aluth. They had all laughed after that. A small victory to celebrate, the death of the traitorous hand. The beach had been worse, the loss of two more Ha'lot'dy, had hit moral again. Only three left, of which Sa'vak was one. He had pleased her, Sa'vak. Killing the small beast on the beach, it had brought her honour. But now, the Naga would have to fight, she would have to risk her own. Nine Naga, nine Leviathans, and three legionnaire's. Against one of those horrible floating fortresses.

This time, they wouldn't be surprised. This time, Saoirse had a plan. The Naga were great soldiers, they could adapt. She would show them, they need not fear these new beings. She would show these new beings, that they had something to fear. So the pack hunted, and they had a scent. The scent of a ship. Below her Sa'vak held fast, with the other two remaining Lot'dy. Aluth gently kissed the rudder, and the three Lot'dy disembarked. Slowly Sa'vak and his companions climbed the rudder. They took out hatchets and began chopping. Aluth fell away and began to fall, diving deep.

As the ship felt the first bites of steel, upon its rudder, it was hit again. This time, there would be no rush, this would be methodical, the Naga would drag the ship down to their level. Each Leviathan took its turn, one after the other. Dive deep, and rise fast. Like torpedoes, living battering rams, they began to smash the ships hull. Again and again, giant jaws, chewing and breaking. Rudderless, the ship began to lean, the Naga controlling the engagement. Slowly it started, the ocean gushing into the heart of the ship. The Leviathans attacking, constantly below the water line, always seeking weakness, never exposing themselves.

Slowly the ship began to sink. The pack circling, picking off any smaller vessels, crushing them outright, containing them within a kill zone. The Leviathans feasted on flesh. Still the attack came, the ships mind screaming with terror, as its body was torn apart. It could feel the crew dying, each mind crying out in anguish, as it was silenced. The Leviathan never coming within reach of its maw, always attacking its back. Poison began to permeate the water, dulling its mind. The ship sinking below the water, paralysed and helpless. The last voice silenced, it would die alone, the last of its large family to perish.

Saoirse left Aluth to circle, as the ship hit the bottom. She swam down to its deck, and began to hack at it. She was joined by the others, the ship powerless to stop them, weighed down by the ocean. The Naga tore it open, and there within it, lay the seed. The seed of a new ship, ready to be born. They freed the seed from its dead parent, and it began to rise.
